XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic shutdown of cabin ventilation during start-up
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | BATTERY | FANS | AIR CONDITIONING | HEATING | AIR | CONDITIONED | VOLTAGE | SPEED | DISPLAY | SCREEN | START | START-UP | SET | SELECTED | SWITCH OFF | STOP | STOPPED | STOPPING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Battery

  • Fault: Sporadically, during the start-up phase, the cabin ventilation switches off, while it works correctly when the vehicle is running

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty battery

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the starter battery and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the faulty battery caused voltage drops, which prevented the fans in the passenger compartment from functioning correctly. Before replacement, the battery still allowed the vehicle to start normally.
